title: HCC single-cell/spatial cancer-switch pilot

anchor.title: Large-scale single-cell analysis and in silico perturbation reveal dynamic evolution of HCC: from initiation to therapeutic targeting
anchor.citation: Xia P, Shuang S, Fu D, et al. npj Precision Oncology. 2026;10:100.
anchor.source_location: WorkSpace/HCC_sc_spatial_npj_2026/PDF与图片; source PDFs and supplements remain outside Git

goal.success_definition: Determine honestly whether the anchor's full evidence chain can be transferred to another cancer, identify candidate diseases and blockers, and expose Paper2Paper gaps before any route is promoted

constraints.compute: Phase 0 real execution on the project cloud server with frozen Python/R environments; later spatial and Geneformer GPU environments remain unqualified
constraints.skills: single-cell RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, donor-aware statistics, Python/R, foundation-model audit

stop_rule: Do not call a cancer-switch route executable until representative target files are parsed, all required comparison groups are adequately represented, the critical code path is smoke-tested, and nearest-paper overlap is resolved
